title: Pneumonia, lung abscess, empyema and respiratory arrest in the hospital
question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the main lung condition (only that code).
note:
Admission Date: 05/12/2026
Discharge Date: 05/20/2026
Reason for Admission: Shortness of breath, productive cough, fever.

Hospital Course:
Pt is an 83 y/o F admitted for evaluation of respiratory symptoms. CT imaging revealed a lung abscess. No evidence of pneumonia elsewhere. Pt started on prolonged course of IV antibiotics. Pt tolerated treatment well; afebrile x48 hrs. Lungs clear to auscultation. Vitals stable. Transitioned to oral meds prior to discharge.

Discharge Diagnoses:
- lung abscess
- Acute respiratory infection

Discharge Medications:
- Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125mg BID x10 days
- Guaifenesin 600mg PRN
- Acetaminophen 650mg PRN

Follow-up:
F/u with PCP in 1 week for wound check and symptom review. Repeat imaging in 6 weeks to monitor abscess resolution.

Electronically signed
P. O'Brien, MD
05/20/2026
refs: ICD-10-CM Tabular: J15-J18, J69, J85-J86, R09

distractors.why: A lung abscess is documented, not pneumonia.
